description: Authored the industry-sponsor pitch migrating holographic communication systems from HoloLens 2 to Meta Quest 3 with AI-based quality enhancement; mentor 5-member undergraduate teams on point cloud capture, transmission, and system integration.

Mentored collegiate developers on bio-computational hackathon projects, system design, and software prototyping.
Delivered hands-on digital literacy and computer education programs across 8 remote schools in partnership with local municipalities.
Led technical operations, organized community sessions during lockdowns, and forged organizational partnerships.
